title: Mile High Hauntings: Guided Ghost Tour in Downtown Denver
blurb:
Explore the chilling tales of Denver's haunted history on this 2.5-hour walking ghost tour through the LoDo district. With an expert guide leading the way, you'll visit the city's most infamous haunted locations and hear spine-tingling stories that bring the supernatural to life. Perfect for history buffs and thrill-seekers alike, this tour offers an immersive experience into the eerie past of Denver. Get ready for an unforgettable evening filled with ghostly legends and local lore.

- 2.5-hour guided walking tour through Denver's haunted LoDo district
- Discover chilling ghost stories and local legends from your expert guide
- Perfect for history enthusiasts and those seeking a spooky adventure
- Experience the eerie atmosphere of downtown Denver's most haunted spots
